patterns.description: Customers frequently complain about poor food quality, receiving poorly prepared or bad-tasting dishes.
Negative feedback regarding rude, inattentive, or unprofessional staff attitude.
Complaints about long wait times for seating, service, or food delivery.
Customer dissatisfaction with high prices relative to the portion size or quality.
Issues related to restaurant cleanliness and hygiene.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently complain about poor food quality, receiving poorly prepared or bad-tasting dishes.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent kitchen execution, lack of standardized recipes, or rushed food preparation during peak hours.

root_causes.pattern: Negative feedback regarding rude, inattentive, or unprofessional staff attitude.
root_causes.cause: Understaffing leading to high stress levels among employees, inadequate customer service training, or poor management oversight.

root_causes.pattern: Complaints about long wait times for seating, service, or food delivery.
root_causes.cause: Kitchen and front-of-house bottlenecking, poor table management, or insufficient staffing levels during busy periods.

root_causes.pattern: Customer dissatisfaction with high prices relative to the portion size or quality.
root_causes.cause: Menu pricing misalignment with customer perceived value, potentially due to recent price increases or shrinking portions.

root_causes.pattern: Issues related to restaurant cleanliness and hygiene.
root_causes.cause: Lack of structured cleaning schedules and inadequate accountability for front-and-back-of-house sanitation tasks during shifts.
